notes: Park Bell (1987 to 1999, 64 items), the newsletter of the St. Mary's Park Improvement Club: every item the Internet Archive collection sanfrancisconewspapers catalogues under that title. Source text is each item's hOCR search text; leaves from its hOCR page index.

coverage.remaining: Nothing in this title: every item the collection holds was read.
coverage.note: 64 items, 1,122 numbered-address mentions; ocr_mentions.py --rescue kept 109 windows, merged into 59 passages, all read by hand. The newsletter is club minutes, garden awards and a page of repeating advertisers; 55 of the 59 passages are the same display ads or members' home addresses. Two findings, both about one shop on Mission Street.

findings.description: Everest's, a convenience store, had newly opened here by June 1998 and gave notice that it meant to sell liquor.

raw.text: venience store that has opened at 4004 Mission Street

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 4004 MISSION ST → parcel 6748001; sf-parcels has blklot 6748001 active, 4000–4004 MISSION; the 2025 roll records it as multi-family residential, built 1910. EAS puts 4000, 4004 MISSION ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 4000.

findings.description: The Board of Supervisors withheld approval of a liquor license for the Everest Market here, and the state Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control then denied it, as reported in August 1998.
